summary: Spec fidelity pass: a leap second (2030-01-01T23:59:60Z, 1998-12-31T23:59:60Z) is taken by all 12 time places exactly as 0.36.0 took it (chrono parse_from_rfc3339), and the payload then holds timestamp 2030-01-01T23:59:60.000000000Z; fractions past 9 digits are cut to the nanosecond. The brief says only that impossible times (25h) are refused and no value table (atip_optionforms_12, NOT_A_DATE_TIME) names :60, so the behavior is unpinned; real-binary matrix 0.36.0 vs 0.37 shows identical answers, so it is no regression. Blast radius: signature payload bytes for :60 vs the next midnight differ though RFC 3339 places them at one instant. Non-blocking.
